summary:
Product Management professional with 12+ years of experience in digital products, automation using AI & ML solutions. Skilled in
product development, agile methodologies, and digital transformation initiatives. Proven expertise in leading teams, optimizing customer
journeys, and scaling revenue growth through data-driven decision-making.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(Team Management→Team Coordination(100%), Sprint planning→Scrum(100%), Customer experience→Customer Experience(100%), scrum→Scrum(100%), Critical Thinking→Problem Solving(100%)...)

jobs.role: Asst. Vice President- Product Management, Digital Business & Transformation
pre_date_header: Axis Bank, Asst. Vice President- Product Management, Digital Business & Transformation, Mumbai
bullets: Led a team of Product Owners to enhance the digital home loan journey, driving platform development and business adoption, scaling Disbursement to ₹2000 Cr annually.

Launched a customer journey on the in-house platform (MLP) for automating operations, reducing TAT from 1 day to 45 minutes by automating consent, payment collection, E-NACH setup, E-Sign and E-Stamp of agreement.

Developed and deployed an end-to-end customer onboarding and disbursement workflow across Maximus Lending Platform (MLP) and Salesforce, integrating back-office modules for Risk Checks, Underwriting, and Operations, reducing sanction TAT to 2 hours.
Optimized funnel conversions by monitoring KPIs for qualified leads and drop-offs, achieving a 3% conversion rates and driving business growth.
Oversaw 40+ API integrations with various fintech partners and internal platforms which helped in achieving 85% approval rate.
Owned the product roadmap, prioritization, & sprint planning, aligning agile strategies with business goals.
Implemented the dashboards on CDP to automate the reporting & actionable insights on business performance matrix.
Collaborated with cross-functional tech and UX/UI teams to develop product features and user-centric journey maps.
Oversaw production support, escalation matrix & issue resolution to ensure seamless user experience.

pre_date_header: CRIF High Mark, Senior Manager- Account Management, Mumbai
bullets: Led consultative sales of information, analytics, and software products in the BFSI sector, aligning offerings with client needs.
Achieved over 100% growth, reaching ₹3.2 Cr in annual revenue for FY 21-22 through targeted account strategies.

Collaborated closely with Product and Analytics teams to understand client requirements, delivering customized solutions such as scorecards, market insight reports, portfolio scrub tools, customer data enrichment, and early warning signals.

Built and maintained strategic relationships with C-suite executives and Department leaders, leveraging insights from these engagements to identify new business opportunities and enhance product-market fit.

Advised financial institutions on data-enabled credit decisioning using AI & ML Models, digital lending, fraud prevention, and market insights, translating client needs into actionable product insights.
Conducted requirement gathering, defined scopes of work, and managed proposal processes to closure, ensuring product alignment and maximizing value for both clients and the organization.

pre_date_header: SBI Card, Regional Sales Manager, Mumbai
bullets: Leading, Mentoring and Managing sales team of 7 ASMs for strategizing and driving sales of credit cards in Mumbai Region.
Implemented Quick Data Entry App for sales, optimizing sales funnel with first region to achieve adoption of 100%.
Effectively managing and maintaining strategic relationship with higher authorities of the channel partners (Banks).
Ensuring Cost of Acquisition per account, product mix is as per business plan to build profitable portfolio.

pre_date_header: Vedanta Resources Plc, Asst. Manager, Jharsuguda (Orissa)
bullets: Managed manpower and resources for smooth execution of operational activities during shifts.
